summaryJa: 2025年、約1700時に複数の米国・連邦・州の要員がヘリコプター（コールサイン[CALL SIGN 1]等）で[SITE CODE NAME]西の山岳地帯を捜索した。2141時以降、LP/OPがFLIRおよびNVGで「"super-hot"」と表現するオーブ／光を検出し、[CALL SIGN 1]が複数回迎撃・捜索を行った。オーブは高速で移動・分裂したと報告され、機体付近（約10フィート以内）まで接近した旨や、二つの物体から何かが出現して別方向へ高速移動したとの副操縦士の目撃がある。西・東・南の山上・上空で、4〜6個のオーブが横一列に順次フレアアップ／フレアダウンする群れや三角形配置などが繰り返し観測された。軍用機が同空域で訓練している報告があり、[CALL SIGN 1]は速度差や燃料不足で追跡を断念し約2316時に基地へ帰還した。目撃者はパイロットが録画していたが多くはヘリのFLIR画角外であり、オーブがヘリから分離して軍用機を追ったように見えたと述べている。
summaryEn: In 2025, at approximately 1700 hours, US, federal, and state personnel departed the operations center by helicopter ([CALL SIGN 1] et al.) to search the mountains west of [SITE CODE NAME]. From about 2141–2320 hours LP/OP using FLIR and NVG reported an orb described as "super-hot" and [CALL SIGN 1] conducted multiple intercept/search attempts. The orb(s) were reported to move at high speed, split into multiple objects, approach within roughly 10 feet of the helicopter, and a co-pilot reported something emerging from two objects and accelerating in a different direction. Repeated observations recorded swarms and formations of 4–6 orbs flaring up and down in horizontal sequences or triangular arrangements over mountain areas to the west, east, and south. Military aircraft were also operating in the area; [CALL SIGN 1] broke off pursuit due to inability to match speed and low fuel, returning to base at about 2316 hours. Witness 1 noted pilots said they were recording but many sightings were outside the helicopter FLIR camera angle, and that the orbs appeared to break off from the helicopter and pursue the military aircraft.
